children.name: At VocalMask we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we handle your information when you use our AI-powered personalized children's song generation services.

children.name: Welcome to VocalMask (vocalmask.com). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your data when you use our AI-powered personalized children's song generation services. By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. We will only use your information as described in this Privacy Policy.
children.characters: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, improve functionality, and provide a better user experience.

children.name: At VocalMask, cookies help us deliver personalized experiences, maintain your session security, and continuously improve our AI-powered song generation services based on user interactions.
